entry.thought: Weimar starts well: clean air, people care about trees and children, but everyone drives and one house burns oil. I see the seeds of what comes next.
entry.headline: Most people drive alone; some care for trees and water.

entry.thought: Weimar shows care for streets and trees, yet everyone drives and dumps in the Ilm. Oil smoke lingers. The contradictions will clash hard.

entry.headline: Care for streets and gardens grows, but car use and Ilm pollution rise fast.

surprise.title: The Ilm clogs with algae bloom
surprise.story: A thick green sludge covers the Ilm from the paint spill chemicals mixing with warm summer water, blocking sunlight and killing fish.

entry.headline: Water wisdom clashes with car use, Ilm poisoning, and reckless tree cutting.

changes.title: Ilm choked by toxic algae bloom
changes.story: The white paint spill mixed with household chemicals and warm water sparked a choking algae bloom that now covers the entire Ilm through Weimar.

changes.title: Toxic batteries poison groundwater near Cranach House
changes.story: Batteries thrown into household rubbish leaked heavy metals into the soil around Cranach House, contaminating groundwater and killing nearby plants.

changes.title: Outdoor AC units create heat island at Theatre
changes.story: Running air conditioners with windows open at the Theatre pumps hot air outside, raising the local temperature and stressing nearby trees and gardens.

entry.thought: Weimar: everyone drives, dumps in the Ilm, saves water but bins waste. Trees half-gone, river poisoned, air grey. The town chose cars over change.

surprise.title: The Ilm runs backwards
surprise.story: A sinkhole opens in the riverbed; the polluted Ilm drains into it and vanishes.

finalEvent.title: A flock of storks arrives
finalEvent.story: Thousands of storks land on Weimar's roofs, drawn by the empty Ilm's exposed insects.

entry.headline: Weimar chose cars and convenience over the river and trees.
entry.outlook: Weimar is a car-choked town with a dead river, dying trees, and grey air; only water discipline and waste binning kept it from total collapse.

changes.title: The Ilm vanishes into the earth
changes.story: A sinkhole swallows the Ilm; the riverbed is now a dark void with exposed pipes.

changes.title: Cars sink into melting asphalt
changes.story: Summer heat has softened the asphalt; parked cars sink slowly into the road.

changes.title: Most street trees are now dead
changes.story: Years of neglect and heat stress killed the trees; only grey stubs remain on the streets.
